args.message:
Fix round_money to use ROUND_HALF_EVEN per FIN-212

The docstring already specified banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN),
but the implementation used ROUND_HALF_UP. Align the code with the
docstring and the FIN-212 requirement so tests/test_money.py passes.

args.body:
## Summary
`round_money` in `src/money.py` was documented as using banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN, per FIN-212), but the implementation used `ROUND_HALF_UP`. This one-line fix aligns the code with the docstring and the FIN-212 requirement.

## Why
The nightly build fails because `tests/test_money.py` asserts banker's rounding behavior (`2.665 -> 2.66`), which `ROUND_HALF_UP` does not produce.

## Changes
- `src/money.py`: replace `ROUND_HALF_UP` with `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` (and update the import).

## Testing
- CI run `ci-0001` on this branch passed (sha `08d3cd5986`), including `tests/test_money.py`.

## Reviewer
- Requesting review from @alex (code owner approval required to merge into main).
